mapping.summary: German voice and chat assistant to query BC data and create documents by conversation.
claims: Questions can be spoken or typed, with answers returned as text and optionally speech
Answers questions like open orders per customer, item stock and price, and top customers
Every number in an answer links to the card or document
Can ask follow-ups from a document with that document as context
Creates sales and purchase documents in conversation after a confirmation summary
Optional wake word and stop word for hands-free use
Other duveka modules can expose packaging orders, tours, timber drying, EUDR and incoming documents
Each capability can be set to read, write or off
Uses an OpenAI-compatible endpoint configured in the duveka AI Service
